title: Repository identification records
description: The per-repo identification records required by the `reference-catalog` capability: one per reference repo, each naming what that repo is and the one thing it contributes that the others do not. `best_at` is not decoration -- it is what stops the four repos being treated as interchangeable sources and keeps the derived vocabulary from being an average of four different opinions.

ha_style.description: Deliberately unordered. An earlier draft required the most characteristic style first, which turned out to be a claim about the repo that nothing could check.

ha_version.description: Checked against the repo's `.HA_VERSION` at curation time, not in CI: the clones are absent from CI by design.

best_at.description: The one thing this repo contributes that the others do not.
